headline: Built for patrollers. Backed by supply chain transparency.
body: Our backcountry shells are crafted to last decades, reducing replace-often waste. Read our exact material sourcing and production audits before investing in $650 pro-grade gear.
rationale: This persona is skeptical of greenwashing and requires hard supply chain facts rather than vague eco claims. The copy addresses their medium price sensitivity by framing the $650 price tag as a long-term investment against fast fashion waste, utilizing their exact messaging preferences.
